sourceTitle: Travels in the Interior of Brazil Principally through the northern provinces, and the gold and diamond districts, during the years 1836-1841
description: "Travels in the Interior of Brazil" by George Gardner is a historical account written in the mid-19th century. This work chronicles Gardner's explorations of Brazil during the years 1836-1841, with a focus on its northern provinces and the regions rich in gold and diamonds.
